items.title: Sweet Williams Interview
items.q: Jeep, Jeep Roussons recorded with him on some recording. That's the last week I know Jeep did.

ctx.x: You know? Yeah, I don't know about that. He didn't have nothing to sell, you know. And he made it pretty good for a while. Yeah. Until he passed out. He had no repertoire. But every song he made was the same thing, but different words. Willie Mabel. Willie Mabel. Jeep, Jeep Roussons recorded with him on some recording. That's the last week I know Jeep did. Yeah. He's been writing in shorts for about twenty years, fifteen years. Now he's in shorts, he's got a car or something. He don't prove the music anymore.
Do you know some of these boogie players still playing in the thirties here in Chicago? No, they ain't got no more boogies around here.
